title: Oak Meadow — Curriculum Sample Coursebooks (PK-12, All Subjects)
notes: Massive collection of 57 coursebook samples spanning PK through high school across all subjects. Waldorf-inspired, child-centered approach. Each sample includes first 2 weeks of lessons plus selections from later. Excellent reference for holistic curriculum design, creative/artistic integration, and developmental staging. Includes unique subjects: drawing & design, photography, painting, forensic science, foodways, global climate change.
